E

endTurn() - Static method in class engine.Game
Advances the game by one turn: Each zombie attacks an adjacent hero (if any). A new zombie spawns at a random empty cell. All cells are hidden (fog-of-war reset). Each active hero's action points are restored and visibility is recalculated. The map is redrawn via Game.onMapUpdate.
